entries.title: Al-Aʿmāl al-Ṣūfīya (Complete Sufi Works: al-Mawāqif and al-Mukhāṭabāt)
entries.author: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Jabbār al-Niffarī (d. 965)
entries.notes: 10th-century Iraqi mystic. Al-Niffari's Mawāqif (Stations) and Mukhāṭabāt (Addresses) are among the most radical Sufi texts — direct address from God to the seeker, foundational for later Sufi metaphysics.

entries.base_filename: السهروردي - نصوص إشراقية، ثلاث رسائل في الرؤية والمجاز
entries.title: Nuṣūṣ Ishrāqīya: Three Treatises on Vision and Metaphor
entries.display_title: نصوص إشراقية، ثلاث رسائل في الرؤية والمجاز
entries.author: Shihāb al-Dīn al-Suhrawardī (d. 1191)
entries.notes: Arabic original of Illuminationist (ishrāqī) texts by Shaykh al-Ishrāq Suhrawardi al-Maqtul. Three treatises on visionary experience and symbolic perception. Library previously only had Urdu edition.

entries.base_filename: التلمساني - شرح فصوص الحكم للشيخ الأكبر ابن عربي
entries.title: Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam (Commentary on Ibn ʿArabī's Bezels of Wisdom)
entries.display_title: شرح فصوص الحكم للشيخ الأكبر ابن عربي
entries.author: ʿAfīf al-Dīn al-Tilimsānī (d. 1291)
entries.notes: Major early commentary on Ibn ʿArabī's Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam by his disciple-once-removed. Foundational text in the Akbarian tradition.

entries.base_filename: جامي - الدرّة الفاخرة في تحقيق مذهب الصوفية والمتكلمين والحكماء المتقدمين
entries.title: Al-Durra al-Fākhira (The Precious Pearl)
entries.display_title: الدرّة الفاخرة في تحقيق مذهب الصوفية والمتكلمين والحكماء المتقدمين
entries.author: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān Jāmī (d. 1492)
entries.notes: Jāmī's Arabic philosophical treatise comparing the doctrines of Sufis, theologians, and earlier philosophers on key metaphysical questions. The last great Persian Sufi poet writing in Arabic prose.
